name: Input
description: Create custom keybindings and retrieve input information.

static_functions.name: Bind
static_functions.description: Binds a function to an Input defined using Register or from the game

static_functions.name: Unbind
static_functions.description: Unbinds an Input function
static_functions.description_long: Unbinds all Input functions related to the given binding_name and input_event

static_functions.name: Register
static_functions.description: Registers a keybinding to a default key

parameters.name: key_name
parameters.description: The Key to use by default if this wasn't set before

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Text to show on Key Bindings Settings

static_functions.name: Unregister
static_functions.description: Unregisters a keybinding

static_functions.name: GetKeyboardLayout
static_functions.description: Gets the keyboard layout of the user

static_functions.name: GetKeyIcon
static_functions.description: Gets the icon path of a key

parameters.name: dark_mode
parameters.description: Whether to return the dark version of the icon

static_functions.name: GetKeyCode
static_functions.description: Gets the key code of a key

static_functions.name: GetModifierKeys
static_functions.description: Gets the currently pressed modifier keys

static_functions.name: GetMappedKeys
static_functions.description: Returns the keys bound to a keybinding

static_functions.name: ResetBindings
static_functions.description: Resets all bound functions by this Package

static_functions.name: GetScriptingKeyBindings
static_functions.description: Returns a table with all Scripting KeyBindings

static_functions.name: GetGameKeyBindings
static_functions.description: Returns a table with all Game KeyBindings

static_functions.name: SetInputEnabled
static_functions.description: Toggles Local Player input

parameters.name: enable_input
parameters.description: Whether to enable Local Player input

static_functions.name: SetMouseEnabled
static_functions.description: Shows or hides the mouse cursor

parameters.name: is_enabled
parameters.description: Whether the mouse cursor is enabled

static_functions.name: SetMouseCursor
static_functions.description: Sets the current Mouse Cursor type

parameters.name: cursor_type
parameters.description: The new current Mouse Cursor type

static_functions.name: GetMouseCursor
static_functions.description: Gets the current Mouse Cursor type

static_functions.name: InputKey
static_functions.description: Forces an Input Key event on Local Player
static_functions.description_long:
Forces an Input Key event on Local Player

This won't trigger any Scripting event as it bypass internal validations

static_functions.name: IsKeyDown
static_functions.description: Returns if a key is being pressed

static_functions.name: IsBindingDown
static_functions.description: Returns if a Key Binding is being pressed
static_functions.description_long:
Returns if a Key Binding is being pressed.

A Binding can be mapped to more than one Key, any of them being pressed is enough for this to return true.

return.description: if the Key Binding is pressed

parameters.name: binding_name
parameters.description: The name of the Key Binding

static_functions.name: IsMouseEnabled
static_functions.description: Gets if the mouse cursor is enabled

static_functions.name: IsInputEnabled
static_functions.description: Gets if the game input is enabled

static_functions.name: Subscribe
static_functions.description: Subscribes to an Event

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Callback to run on the event occurring

static_functions.name: Unsubscribe
static_functions.description: Unsubscribes from all subscribed Events in this Class and in this Package, optionally passing the function to unsubscribe only that callback

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Optional callback to specifically unsubscribe to
